description: This file defines a custom exception class SystemCheckException within the OrangeHRM Installer Exception namespace, providing specific static methods for common system check errors related to PHP extensions.

classes.name: SystemCheckException
classes.description: A custom exception class extending PHP's base Exception class, providing static methods for specific error messages related to system requirements checks during installation.

methods.name: notEnabledPDOExtension
methods.description: Returns a new instance of SystemCheckException with a message indicating the PDO extension is not enabled.

methods.name: notEnabledPDOMySQLDriver
methods.description: Returns a new instance of SystemCheckException with a message indicating the pdo_mysql extension is not enabled.
